text.p: Swiss restaurant and hotel group Moevenpick AG said it remained cautious due to difficult economic conditions in its main markets but still expected a higher 1996 net profit than last year.
A Moevenpick spokesman later specified that the gorup expected 1996 net after taxes to be 17.5 million Swiss francs, after 15.2 million Swiss francs last year.
"Our forecast for the year is 17.5 million (Swiss francs)," spokesman Emil Egger said when asked about the net profit forecast.
Moevenpick's interim report said growth in hotel business and rising profitability in its restaurants made it confident of higher profits for the year.
However, it warned that "business conditions in our main markets Switzerland and Germany remain negative."
